items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I had Snooky, Snooky Young, Ernie Royal, Bill Berry, Tony Studd, Frank Wess, Jerome Richardson, Jimmy Hamilton. Who else? Oh, Milt Hinton, Hank Jones. It was a good band.

ctx.x: You know, we fell in love with the Ellington outfit. In fact I think everybody was crazy about Duke, and then -- of course Basie and Lionel Hampton, I think, was one of the guys that really drew some attention at the Grand Terrace. He had quite an outfit. Sir Charles Thompson on piano, Marshall Royal, Ernie Royal, Ray Perry, the jazz violinist, and another fellow named Beckett who was quite a trombone player. You know, they had quite an outfit. Before Hamp got into his wild setup.
